from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Data from storyboard/outline
        title = "Vector Addition: Combining Forces"
        lecture_lines = [
            "Adding vectors combines two different forces into one.",
            "Place the tail of the second vector at the first's tip.",
            "The 'resultant' vector connects the starting point to the end.",
            "Algebraically, we simply add the corresponding coordinates together.",
            "This sum represents the total displacement from both movements."
        ]
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)

        # Colors for visual consistency
        color_a = "#1E90FF"  # DodgerBlue for Vector A
        color_b = "#32CD32"  # LimeGreen for Vector B
        color_c = "#FF1493"  # DeepPink for Resultant Vector C
        color_math = "#FFD700" # Gold for Algebra

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Show Vector A (East) and Vector B (North). Highlight lecture line 1.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(color_a))
        
        # Vector A: East direction, from grid D2 to D4 (2 units)
        vector_a = Arrow(self.grid["D2"], self.grid["D4"], buff=0, color=color_a)
        label_a = MathTex(r"\vec{A}", color=color_a, font_size=24).next_to(vector_a, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        
        # Vector B: North direction, from grid E5 to C5 (2 units) - Separated initially
        vector_b = Arrow(self.grid["E5"], self.grid["C5"], buff=0, color=color_b)
        label_b = MathTex(r"\vec{B}", color=color_b, font_size=24).next_to(vector_b, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vector_a), Write(label_a))
        self.play(GrowArrow(vector_b), Write(label_b))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Move Vector B to Vector A's tip (Tip-to-Tail). Highlight lecture line 2.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(color_b)
        )
        
        # Vector A's tip is at grid D4. We move Vector B's tail to D4.
        # New Vector B position: D4 (Tail) to B4 (Tip)
        shift_vector = self.grid["D4"] - self.grid["E5"]
        
        self.play(
            vector_b.animate.shift(shift_vector),
            label_b.animate.shift(shift_vector)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Draw Resultant Vector C from the start of A to the end of B. Highlight lecture line 3.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(color_c)
        )
        
        # Resultant starts at D2 and ends at B4
        vector_c = Arrow(self.grid["D2"], self.grid["B4"], buff=0, color=color_c)
        label_c = MathTex(r"\vec{C} = \vec{A} + \vec{B}", color=color_c, font_size=28)
        self.place_at_grid(label_c, "B2", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vector_c))
        self.play(Write(label_c))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        # Show the algebraic addition of components. Highlight lecture line 4.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(color_math)
        )
        
        # Component labels (assuming 1 grid unit = 1 coordinate unit)
        # Vector A = (2, 0), Vector B = (0, 2)
        coord_a = MathTex(r"(2, 0)", color=color_a, font_size=20).next_to(vector_a, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        coord_b = MathTex(r"(0, 2)", color=color_b, font_size=20).next_to(vector_b, RIGHT, buff=0.4)
        
        # Resultant calculation
        sum_formula = MathTex(r"(2, 0) + (0, 2) = (2, 2)", color=color_math, font_size=32)
        self.place_at_grid(sum_formula, "F4", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(Write(coord_a), Write(coord_b))
        self.play(Write(sum_formula))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        # Conclude with the meaning of the displacement. Highlight lecture line 5.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[3].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[4].animate.set_color(color_c)
        )
        
        # Pulse the resultant vector for emphasis
        self.play(vector_c.animate.set_stroke(width=10), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(vector_c.animate.set_stroke(width=4), run_time=0.5)
        self.wait(2)
